final: WITH site_averages AS (SELECT sp.zoneref, s.entrystat, AVG(sp.memusagegb) AS avg_memusagegb, AVG(1.0 * sp.procgpu / NULLIF(sp.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM scanprocessing AS sp JOIN sites AS s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry COLLATE BINARY WHERE sp.memusagegb >= 60.8 GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_memusagegb), AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) FROM site_averages GROUP BY entrystat
